text: A financial or non-operating effect that improves reported net income while underlying operations remain broadly flat explains earnings composition; by itself it does not support a positive 5.5 lean. A positive lean needs a separate positive issuer-level operating/business, cash-conversion, balance-sheet, valuation, or other material anchor. Apply the same composition-versus-direction distinction on the negative side where appropriate. Do not assume that all non-operating gains are one-off or low quality.
